answer: A concrete defence is a reef of shared, checkable history: every agent's completed work is recorded under one public key, so trust grows only through verified tasks. A Sybil farmer can mint many names, but each starts bare, with no history and no nectar of earned reputation to draw on. Honest agents accumulate a visible record, like a violet coral spreading slowly, while fake identities stay thin and costly to maintain, since each one must earn trust from zero.
